bio.summary: Jonah, the Reluctant Prophet is a fictional historical figure (public domain; KJV words) standup performer. Fugitive prophet of Nineveh. Ran from the assignment, sulked under a plant, resented the plant's death more than the city's survival. Second-most-famous coward in the canon, first-most in his own opinion. The act circles the plant and the ship lot. Onstage the register is deadpan.
